name: Diffusion Studio Core
summary: TypeScript video composition engine for the browser: layers, transitions, effects, keyframes, masks and captions on a timeline, decoded and encoded with WebCodecs and drawn on Canvas 2D, built on Mediabunny. Aimed at people building non-linear editors. Requires COOP/COEP headers. Free tier stamps a watermark on renders unless a paid licence key is bought.
use_when: Building an in-browser editor UI that needs a ready timeline model and client-side export
Reading its API as a reference for a WebCodecs-based layer compositor
avoid_when: Server-side or CI rendering: its own README recommends Remotion; Playwright into FFmpeg for VCR
Unwatermarked output without paying: FFmpeg or Mediabunny directly
Alpha overlays and deliverables: FFmpeg filtergraph is the compositor today
license: MPL-2.0; watermark on output unless a paid licence key is purchased
notes: 2026-10-26: npm latest is 4.0.3 (2025-11-30) while the GitHub latest release tag is v1.1.1 (2024-10); version numbering differs between sources.
2026-10-26: no commits since 2025-11-18; no deprecation notice.
2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: Further research first: its editor-focused browser API and watermark constraint need a concrete VCR use case before a skill.

assessment.rationale: Browser-only, last npm release 2025-11-30 and last push 2025-11-18, still within 12 months but nearly a year idle. Output watermarked without a paid key. Mediabunny covers I/O; FFmpeg covers composition. Candidate rather than catalogued.
